company.name: Speed
company.shortDescription: Speed is a leading Bitcoin Payment Processor.
company.description: Speed is a leading Bitcoin payment processor for businesses and individuals to easily accept Bitcoin payments. They provide instant transactions and ensure all the transactions are secure protecting merchants and customers from any fraudulent attempt. Customers can choose to pay via any on-chain or lightning network, Speed is compatible with more than 100 wallets. With its user-friendly interface, integration with various shopping carts, and support for multiple languages, Speed makes it easy for merchants of all sizes to start accepting Bitcoin payments.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $8,000,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $40,340,321 to $40,340,321, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 73 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
